findings.label: Date header through proxy/build unverified
findings.detail: A-1 relies on the error-response Date header reaching the browser through the Vite proxy and the production build; unit tests mock it via FakeBff, e2e could not run. If it does not arrive in a real build, every retrying case fails closed to 'CHƯA in' (degrades to A-2 for that case, still satisfies invariant K). The design itself marked this 'chưa đo'. Measure on an environment where the Medplum stack stands up before the 13/11 demo.

findings.label: Residual case 3 (401 store-close race) unmeasured
findings.detail: The design flags that a 401 at sign time could close the local store before promotion finishes writing; the e2e offline-conflict case meant to measure it was written but not executed. Not a regression introduced by this fix, but unconfirmed.

findings.label: e2e suite not executed
findings.detail: pnpm e2e:cycles could not run because the shared Medplum stack needs openssl (absent) to seed RSA keys and .env, and stack:up uses Bash redirection that breaks under PowerShell. The three e2e edits pass node --check but are unexecuted. Reported honestly as not-passing. Run the 100-cycle (seed 558698034) and 20-cycle 429 scenarios where the stack is available. The user accepted this outcome.
